exact_contract: Every reported arm matched exhaustive full-corpus WRRF ordered Top-K.

static_shared_full_counterexample.scenario: correlated ranks with one Sparse term per channel
static_shared_full_counterexample.conclusion: Posting overlap alone cannot route an eager full evaluator because Dynamic WRRF may certify after a tiny rank prefix.

probe_then_shared_ablation.frozen_probe_rule: Probe each Sparse stream to Top-K, force a WRRF certificate check, then prefix-verify any replacement stream.
probe_then_shared_ablation.conclusion: Resumable replacement protects the early-stop counterexample but duplicated posting work prevents it from becoming the default.

shared_lazy.mechanism: The first channel to open an aligned document batch decodes union-term postings once and materializes exact batch scores for every Sparse channel; channel bounds and rank streams remain independent.
shared_lazy.frozen_router: Superseded by the rank-sharing-aware U<D rule: U is union posting volume for SharedLazy and D is deduplicated independent posting volume after bitwise-identical, equal-WRRF-weight Sparse rank streams are coalesced. Select SharedLazy iff U<D; otherwise use PostingBlock plus transparent rank replay. The rule is training-free and qrels-blind.
shared_lazy.claim_limit: Physical decode reuse is established. Latency advantage remains preliminary until counterbalanced repetitions, larger real corpora, mmap/filter tests, CPU counters, and confidence intervals are complete.
